import numpy as np, scipy.optimize as so
e=df['eps'].values; T=df['T'].values; s=df['sigma'].values
V=np.var(s)
def nm(pred): return np.mean((s-pred)**2)/V
models={
 'log': lambda p: -((p[0]+p[1]*T+p[2]*T**2)*(1-np.exp(-p[3]*T**p[4]*e**p[5])) + (p[6]+p[7]*T)*e + p[8]*np.log(1+p[9]*e**2)),
 'rat': lambda p: -((p[0]+p[1]*T+p[2]*T**2)*(1-np.exp(-p[3]*T**p[4]*e**p[5])) + (p[6]+p[7]*T)*e + p[8]*e**2/(1+p[9]*e)),
 'logT': lambda p: -((p[0]+p[1]*T+p[2]*T**2)*(1-np.exp(-p[3]*T**p[4]*e**p[5])) + (p[6]+p[7]*T)*e + p[8]*np.log(1+p[9]*e)),
 'log2': lambda p: -((p[0]+p[1]*T+p[2]*T**2)*(1-np.exp(-p[3]*T**p[4]*e**p[5])) + (p[6]+p[7]*T)*e + (p[8]+p[10]*T)*np.log(1+p[9]*e**2)),
}
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
for name,f in models.items():
    npar=11 if name=='log2' else 10
    best=(9,None)
    for trial in range(60):
        p0=rng.normal(0,1,npar)
        try:
            r=so.least_squares(lambda p: s-f(p), p0, max_nfev=3000)
            v=nm(f(r.x))
            if np.isfinite(v) and v<best[0]: best=(v,r.x)
        except Exception as ex: pass
    print(name, best[0], np.round(best[1],4))
